title: Determinant
description: A cinematic Forge mod where LOVE, identity, and world reactions escalate into powerful, high-impact abilities.
body:
# Determinant

Determinant is not a normal Minecraft mod.

This is a long-term progression experience where the player slowly turns into a walking cataclysm. Every action matters, every fight pushes you further, and over time the world stops treating you like just another player.

---

## What is Determinant?

At its core, Determinant is about **choice, identity, and escalation**.

You are not forced into one path.

You can:
- Stay peaceful and try to coexist with the world
- Go full genocide and let everything spiral out of control
- Or exist somewhere in the middle, where things get… strange

As your LOVE increases, the world begins to react. Mobs behave differently. The atmosphere changes. The tone shifts. You’re not just playing Minecraft anymore — you’re changing it.

---

## Core Features

### ⚔️ LOVE Progression
- Gain power through combat and decisions  
- The higher your LOVE, the more dangerous you become  
- The world becomes less forgiving the further you go  

---

### 🧠 Chara Identity System
- You’re not just a player — you become something the game recognizes  
- Dialogue, reactions, and presence evolve over time  
- The mod actively responds to who you’re becoming  

---

### 🌍 World Response
- The world is not neutral  
- Mobs, environments, and encounters react to your state  
- At higher levels, things can turn hostile very quickly  

---

### 💥 Cinematic Combat & Abilities
- High-impact attacks designed to feel powerful, not just effective  
- Shockwaves, large-scale effects, and chaotic encounters  
- Combat is meant to feel like a full escalation, not just clicking mobs  

---

### ☠️ Death Refusal
- Death isn’t always the end  
- Expect massive visual events and intense moments when it triggers  

---

### 🎥 Cinematics (Optional)
- **CMDCam support** for dynamic camera movement during major events  
- Turns fights and abilities into full scenes  

---

### ✨ Visual Enhancements (Optional)
- **Photon integration** for more cinematic effects and visuals  

---

### 🗣️ Living World (Planned / Expanding)
- Villagers and entities will become more interactive  
- Dialogue systems will expand over time  
- The goal is a world that feels aware of what you’ve done  

---

## The Goal

Over multiple updates, Determinant is being built into:

> A 3D Undertale-inspired, anime-level chaos simulator  
> where the player can become anything from peaceful to completely unstoppable.

This is not about balance.

This is about **how far you decide to go**.

---

## ⚠️ Beta Notice

- This is an early beta  
- Features will be expanded and refined over time  
- Multiplayer is experimental  
- Back up important worlds before testing major abilities  

---

## 📦 Requirements

- **GeckoLib (Required)**

---

## 🧩 Optional (Recommended)

- **CMDCam** – cinematic camera system  
- **Photon** – enhanced visuals  

---

## Final Note

At low levels, the world feels normal.

At high LOVE…

it doesn’t.

You’ll understand when you get there.
